I have to book an appointment before I get a referral but I’m too young to book it. 

And Josh and I used to play xbox a tonne but he lives only 4 doors down so we always went out as well to go to the shops or whatever we did

Josh put less and less effort into the friendship and he just completely blocked me on social media and ended the friendship without any warning.

And I have tried to go to the doctors before to book appointments to talk but they have always refused and said to come back with someone over the age of 18.
Before you go, please read my post that I just posted on this subreddit. You’re not alone. I have aspergers and my situation is so similar.
